name: devnexus-web
description: DevNexus — Universal Dynamic Pricing Platform. Analyst web application.

scripts.//deploy: Builds, strips the sourcemaps from dist, then publishes. The maps are written for local debugging but must not be uploaded: they are 3.3MB of the 4.2MB output and they publish the full source.
scripts.deploy: npm run build && find dist -name '*.map' -delete && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=devnexus --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
